scope: Real public Zenodo scalar Parquet feasibility, not PPDS or a fair cross-format timing comparison

limitations: Two scalar selections on one public file; not the complete PPDS multimodal dataset
One measured run per selection; network times do not establish a performance ranking
Native Polars result verified, but its wire transfer is not measured
URL+filesystem discovery GET200 bodies may be buffered without explicit read(); only known-size range-only adapters establish bounded partial response bodies
Whole-file local-reference download is separate from every measured remote reader
